source.name: CBS Sports - Asian Tour joins partnership with PGA Tour, DP World Tour effective immediately

note: PIF-funded LIV Golf partnered with the Asian Tour from the league's 2022 launch, creating and funding the International Series; the partnership ended when the Asian Tour joined the PGA Tour / DP World Tour strategic alliance on 21 July 2026 (CBS Sports). AFP via Philstar (2026-07-22) reports LIV had bankrolled the International Series to the tune of $300m, and that PIF announced earlier in 2026 it would stop funding LIV after the 2026 season. Existing claim liv-pif-funding covers the PIF-LIV funding.
